content: 1. Perform lipid screening in youth with type 2 diabetes after achieving optimal glycemic control, and repeat this screening on an annual basis. 2. The target lipid levels should include an LDL cholesterol level of less than 100 mg/dL, an HDL cholesterol level greater than 35 mg/dL, and triglyceride levels below 150 mg/dL. 3. If the desired lipid levels are not achieved, dietary modifications should be implemented. If lipid levels remain elevated after six months of dietary intervention, pharmacologic treatment should be considered. 4. Initiate statin therapy in cases where LDL cholesterol levels exceed 130 mg/dL and do not improve despite lifestyle modifications.
